logline: While Alexander reassures Juliana of their unbreakable bond amid the council's opposition, a destitute Catherine begs for sanctuary at Ashbourne—only for Juliana to offer her survival under the strict humiliation of a scullery maid.
continuity_notes: Follows Episode 46's ecclesiastical challenge by the High Priest. While Catherine plots in secret to remain on the estate, the morning brings her disgrace to light as Juliana decides her fate.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle focus on a dripping candle burning on a wooden table beside a dark window looking out into the misty night.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Catherine in a lace nightgown and lilac robe, holding a goblet of red wine with cold determination.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Calculated, Defiant)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Rupert is rotting in the undercroft cells. Not me. I intend to stay on this estate.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Two-shot framing Catherine in the background with a muscular, bare-chested conspirator standing in shadow beside her.

segments.label: CONSPIRATOR (Low, Warning)
segments.speaker: CONSPIRATOR
segments.text: Alexander will scour the grounds at first light. The High Council has already blocked the marriage registry.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up profile of Catherine leaning close to the man's shoulder, her eyes burning with ambition.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Commanding, Scheming)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Then you will make sure I remain inside these walls.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Silhouette shot against the tall arched window as Catherine turns her back to him.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Ruthless, Focused)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Keep the council paralyzed. I will do the rest.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Atmospheric wide pan across the spacious master bedroom, daylight spilling softly through tall Gothic windows onto the hearth fire.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Alexander and Juliana sitting together on the edge of the velvet bed, dressed in morning robes.

segments.label: JULIANA (Anxious, Trembling)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: What if Father Thomas sways the High Council?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's distressed face, tears shimmering in her eyes as she looks up at Alexander.

segments.label: JULIANA (Vulnerable, Fearful)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: What if they strip your title? Because of me?

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana looks down at her hands, turning over her scarred palms shaped by years of herbal work.

segments.label: JULIANA (Despairing)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I am only a healer. The lords will never accept me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Profile shot as Alexander reaches out and firmly clasps Juliana's trembling hands in his own.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Gentle, Resolute)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Look at me, Juliana.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander raising his scarred hand to tenderly cradle Juliana's cheek.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Fierce, Loving)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: You saved my mother's life. You stood by me when I had nothing.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up on Alexander's gaze locking onto Juliana's tearful eyes.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Deep, Unwavering)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: You are my wife.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander gently pulls Juliana closer, his hands resting securely on her shoulders.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Steadfast)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: You were my wife before that priest ever opened his mouth. And we will stand before the King and God again within ten days. Nothing breaks that.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide establishing shot of the rain-drenched cobblestone courtyard surrounded by imposing Gothic arches.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Lady Ashbourne leaning heavily on her walking cane, glaring down at Catherine who kneels in the mud.

segments.label: LADY ASHBOURNE (Sharp, Contemptuous)
segments.speaker: LADY ASHBOURNE
segments.text: You dare show your face in Ashbourne courtyard?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in her disheveled burgundy gown, clutching her skirts and weeping profusely.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Desperate, Weeping)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: I have nowhere to go, Your Grace.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot tracking Catherine clutching her chest in agony.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Sobbing, Pleading)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: London closed its doors! My family disowned me!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Lady Ashbourne, her gloved hand resting on her cane as she delivers her cold judgment.

segments.label: LADY ASHBOURNE (Cold, Unforgiving)
segments.speaker: LADY ASHBOURNE
segments.text: She aided the poison in my veins. Cast her into the road.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Vaughn drawing his baton, ready to seize Catherine from behind.

segments.label: VAUGHN (Gruff, Ready)
segments.speaker: VAUGHN
segments.text: One command, Your Grace, and I drag her past the gates.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot as Alexander strides purposefully into the courtyard alongside Juliana, his coat billowing behind him.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Furious, Decisive)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Do it, Vaughn! Throw her past the estate perimeter!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine collapsed on the wet stones, looking up with tear-streaked panic.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Hysterical, Screaming)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Please, Alexander! Have mercy!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana raising her right hand firmly to halt the guard.

segments.label: JULIANA (Clear, Authoritative)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Stop.

scenes.heading: INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Alexander turning toward Juliana in sheer disbelief.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Indignant, Protective)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Juliana, she tried to destroy you!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana maintaining serene poise.

segments.label: JULIANA (Calm, Composed)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: She did.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium tracking shot as Juliana steps gracefully past Alexander toward Catherine.

segments.label: JULIANA (Dignified, Principled)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: But Ashbourne does not throw beggars into the mud.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana walks to a side bench, picks up a rough servant's apron and a heavy iron ring of keys, and turns back to face Catherine.

segments.label: JULIANA (Steely, Direct)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: If you seek shelter in this house, Catherine, you earn it.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine's face turning from despair to offended shock.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Incredulous, Stunned)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: You want me? As a guest?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana staring straight into Catherine's eyes without blinking.

segments.label: JULIANA (Unflinching, Firm)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: As a scullery maid.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine recoiling in disgust, looking around at the gathered estate retainers.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Outraged, Venomous)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: You expect me to scrub floors before these commoners?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Dramatic profile two-shot of Juliana standing inches away from Catherine, dominating the confrontation.

segments.label: JULIANA (Measured, Commanding)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You will scrub the floors you walked on as an impostor.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Juliana extends the ring of iron keys outward in her fist.

segments.label: JULIANA (Stern, Demanding)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You will scrub the manor hearths at dawn.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close profile two-shot of the two women locked in an intense psychological battle.

segments.label: JULIANA (Unforgiving)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You will scour the kitchen grease until midnight.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Juliana presents the rough hemp apron and heavy keys right to Catherine's face.

segments.label: JULIANA (Stern, Final)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: One complaint from the housekeeper, and you are cast out with nothing.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine's trembling lips, humiliated tears spilling down her heavily made-up cheeks.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Choked, Humiliated)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: You humiliate me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of both women standing beneath the cathedral vaulting of the hall.

segments.label: JULIANA (Calm, Sovereign)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I offer you bread and honest labor. Take the apron, or leave the county.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up on Catherine's trembling hands as she reaches out, taking the coarse apron and clattering iron keys, pressing them desperately against her chest.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Broken, Defeated)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: I accept, Your Grace.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot down the vaulted stone hall as Catherine prostrates herself entirely upon the floor before Alexander, Juliana, and Lady Ashbourne, humbled to the stone as the scene cuts to black.
